title: Storyboard: a Style field (default realistic) and a Review Plan button
description: Fabio 2026-10-27. (1) Style field, default Realistic: the APP puts the style on every panel and cast picture, the planner writes none, so a style change needs no re-plan; the picture describer stops naming an art style (its 'pixel art'/'anime'/'3D' cast lines clashed with '2D flat cartoon' on the robot board). (2) Review Plan button beside Plan with Cosmo: the idea at plan time is stored; editing the idea no longer wipes a Cosmo plan (MpiBaseFlow _setFlowField does today); Review sends the planner the current plan (with the user's edits) plus the diff of the idea (and panel count), it answers only the changed sections, code merges them; disabled with no plan or no change; reachable by Cosmo. Measure and report a Review press vs a Plan press price/time. Look of the field and button = Fabio's call (pick offered: dropdown under Video shape; smaller Review Plan button beside Plan with Cosmo). Optional later: reuse drawn cast pictures whose line did not change.
